:::{#def-leverage}
#### Leverage

Consider a linear model fitted by [ordinary least squares](correlation-regression.qmd#def-ols),
in which observation $i$ has
[covariate vector](correlation-regression.qmd#def-slr-covariate-vector) $\vxi$
(the model's terms at observation $i$;
for a model with an intercept,
a 1 followed by terms such as $x_i$ and $x_i^2$),
and $A \eqdef \sumin \soprod{\vxi}$ is invertible.
The **leverage** of observation $i$ is

$$
\lev{i} \eqdef \vxi^{\top} A^{-1} \vxi.
$$ {#eq-leverage}

::: {.attribution}
Source: @james2021islr2e [sec. 3.3.3],
written here with the covariate vectors and the matrix $A$ of [the vector form of the OLS estimates](correlation-regression.qmd#thm-ols-slr-vector).
In R, `hatvalues()` returns the leverages of an `lm` fit.
:::

:::
